dataset_summary.interpretation: Candidate priorities identify records for further pharmacovigilance review and do not establish safety signals, causality, incidence, disproportionality, or interactions.

candidates.evidence_summary: Acute kidney injury was reported in 22 Bisoprolol-containing cases (2.15% of the analyzed cohort). 22 cases were classified as serious, including 1 death-associated case(s) and 15 hospitalization-associated case(s). The candidate is assigned higher_priority_candidate for review purposes only. This classification does not establish causality, incidence, disproportionality, or a confirmed safety signal.
candidates.follow_up_recommendation: Prioritize for detailed case review, temporal assessment, clinical context review, confounder assessment, and external evidence evaluation.

candidates.evidence_summary: Drug ineffective was reported in 11 Bisoprolol-containing cases (1.07% of the analyzed cohort). 11 cases were classified as serious, including 0 death-associated case(s) and 1 hospitalization-associated case(s). candidates.follow_up_recommendation: Perform focused case review and evaluate clinical context, co-medications, underlying disease, temporal information, and external evidence.

limitations.limitation: No internal non-Bisoprolol comparator cohort is available.
limitations.impact: ROR and PRR cannot be calculated from this dataset.

limitations.limitation: The dataset consists of reported safety cases.
limitations.impact: Reporting frequency does not provide an incidence denominator.
limitations.restriction: Reported percentages must not be interpreted as incidence.

limitations.limitation: Observed candidate reactions are descriptive case patterns.
limitations.impact: Temporal, clinical, and confounding information may be incomplete.
limitations.restriction: Causality must not be inferred from frequency alone.

limitations.limitation: Multiple concomitant medications occur in many cases.
limitations.restriction: Co-medication presence does not establish interaction.

limitations.limitation: Spontaneous safety-report data may contain reporting biases.
limitations.impact: Observed reporting patterns may not reflect underlying risk.
limitations.restriction: Candidate ranking is review prioritization only.

reporting_rules.role: Generate human-readable pharmacovigilance summaries from validated structured data only.
prohibited_tasks: Do not declare a confirmed safety signal.
Do not declare a confirmed adverse reaction.
Do not declare a confirmed drug-drug interaction.
Do not create an artificial comparator cohort.
Do not interpret review priority as causal importance.
required_language: State that causality is not established.
State that disproportionality was not assessed because no internal non-Bisoprolol comparator was available.
State that co-medication patterns do not establish drug-drug interactions.
reporting_rules.interpretation_scope: Descriptive and exploratory pharmacovigilance review prioritization only.
